desc: Derive the probability that edge i lies on the u–v path for each case (i<u: 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)); i=u: (u-1)/u; u<i<v: 1/i; i=v: 1; i>v: 0), with induction proof that Pr[both descend] = 2/(i(i+1)).
Verify derivations against brute force for small N (hand-checked N=3 query (2,3); N=4 queries (2,4) and (3,4) — all match).
Determine combined formula: Ans(u,v) = (N-1)! · [S1[u-1] + (u≥2)·A_u(u-1)/u + S2[v-1]-S2[u] + A_v], with S1 over 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)) and S2 over 1/i.
Rewrite the solution code with corrected coefficients and precompute inv up to N+1.
Run the corrected code against the three provided samples and a brute-force checker for small N — all match (samples 1–3 exact; exhaustive N=2..6 vs enumeration).
Edge-case check: N=2, adjacent u,v (v=u+1), u=1, large A_i mod handling — covered by formula structure and brute-force tests.
